steps.name: Install declared pnpm and frozen workspace
Run static checks and all workspace tests
Run DialectOS Hermes plugin regressions
argv: apt-get update -qq >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y -qq python3-venv >/dev/null 2>&1; ci_venv="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dialectos-hermes-venv"; git clone --quiet --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --depth 1 https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent.git .hermes-v023-runtime && git -C .hermes-v023-runtime fetch --quiet --depth 1 origin 2bd378ed1b8d6bf2192cb26e0a55ff3091e6bd19 && git -C .hermes-v023-runtime checkout --quiet FETCH_HEAD && python3 -m venv "$ci_venv" && "$ci_venv/bin/pip" install --quiet "pytest==8.4.2" "PyYAML==6.0.3" "packaging==26.0" "python-dotenv==1.2.2" "rich==14.3.3" "ruamel.yaml==0.18.16" "httpx==0.28.1" "requests==2.33.0" "fastapi==0.162.0" && HERMES023_PATH="$PWD/.hermes-v023-runtime" "$ci_venv/bin/python" -m pytest plugins/dialectos-hermes/tests -q
